hooks.logic:
Set the next state to nothing.
If the register's 'inStateHp' minus the value "hp" of the enemy is more than the register's 'deformThreshold', then set the next state to 21.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'stayTurn' is less than 2, then
    Increase the register's 'stayTurn' by one.
    (call game:Commander.getInstance) → register with (the built-in move DO_NOTHING, the enemy).
    Set the next state to 22.
  Otherwise, set the next state to 23.

Otherwise, return the next state.

Set the state settings's 'abilityOptions''s 'messageId' to v.

Set the register's 'deformThreshold' to 0.1 times the value "maxHp" of the enemy.
